name: IRO_agent
headline: Evidence-driven, strictly read-only diagnostic AI agent for industrial software systems
description: IRO_agent (Industrial Read-Only Agent) is an evidence-driven, strictly read-only diagnostic AI agent for industrial software systems. It learns a project's operational model, investigates incidents through iterative evidence gathering, and scores the quality of its own diagnosis using reproducible evaluation datasets. It runs three closed-loop harnesses: Project Learning (builds what the system is), Investigation (finds what actually went wrong via per-round re-planning), and Evaluation (grades the diagnosis itself).
abstract: Industrial diagnostic AI agent with strict read-only safety, evidence provenance, per-round dynamic re-planning, competing-hypothesis lifecycle, knowledge modeling of unknowns, and reproducible evaluation grading.
operatingSystem: Windows, Linux (on-premise and air-gapped industrial PCs)

about.role: Diagnoses incidents in industrial software systems such as scheduling/dispatcher systems (e.g. WES), PostgreSQL-backed business databases, service logs, and dynamic web pages (DevExpress Blazor Server, Vue, React, ASP.NET WebForms).
about.safetyBoundary: Strict read-only: no file writes, no Git commits, no business-database writes, no arbitrary shell execution against the diagnosed system.
about.evidenceModel: Every claim must be anchored to a concrete log line, configuration key, or database record.

featureList: Competing-hypothesis lifecycle (2-5 hypotheses: add, edit, merge, discard)
KnowledgeUnknown first-class objects for blind spots and uncertainty
Layered deterministic graders (deterministic, evidence-grounding, safety, path-quality)
DEV / REGRESSION / BLIND dataset layering for reproducible evaluation

audienceType: Industrial software maintainers (WES, ERP, backend services)

github.about: Evidence-driven, strictly read-only diagnostic AI agent for industrial software systems — Project Learning + Investigation + Evaluation harnesses.
